summary: Iteration 2 backend testing — 18/18 tests passed. Validated new endpoints GET /api/achievements (13 items, structure, unlock logic for first_block/sprout/chapter_slayer) and GET /api/public-profile (structure, recent lists, stats, name+linkedin propagation). Verified XP clamp (max(0,...)) prevents total_xp from going negative even after toggling a 10M-XP task off twice. Light regression on profile/tasks/jee/pomodoro/habits/meds/meditation/career/programs/dashboard/AI chat all green. No mongo _id leaked anywhere.
critical_code_review_comments: compute_achievements() recomputes counts for every /api/achievements and /api/public-profile call — fine at single-user scale but consider caching if multi-user added.

public-profile exposes the entire achievements list (including locked progress.cur counters like total pomodoro mins, jee_done) — acceptable for a personal share page; document this as intentional if privacy becomes a concern.

habits_today counts toggled habits (anything with done=True today) — grassroots achievement uses this same query, which is correct, but note grassroots requires ALL 10 habits done today (currently >=10 which is fine since DEFAULT_HABITS has exactly 10).
award_xp() streak logic: when last_active_date == today, streak is left as-is (no max(streak,1) branch) — first-ever XP on a fresh profile correctly sets streak=1. OK.
ai_chat raises HTTPException(500) on LLM failure but ai_tip silently returns a fallback string — inconsistent UX; consider unifying behaviour.
seed_data_creation: Created/cleaned-up TEST_-prefixed task, med, pomodoro entries within tests; profile.name was set to 'TEST_PublicName' as part of public-profile patch test (existing player data otherwise preserved).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 1 suite (test_backend_api.py) and Iteration 2 suite (test_achievements_public.py) both pass. Profile.name is currently 'TEST_PublicName' from the public-profile patch test — main agent may want to PATCH /api/profile back to a real display name before user-facing demos. XP clamp confirmed working via 10M-XP toggle scenario.
